markdownRemark.html:
The President oversees the general running and direction of EUSO, representing the orchestra within the university and coordinating the committee.

  • Course: 3rd Year Mathematics & Music
  • Instrument: Violin
  • Favourite piece of music: Partita in G minor – J.S. Bach
  • Favourite thing about EUSO: The amazing musical community & the challenge!

Here are a few words from Poppy:

Hi I'm Poppy the 2026-2027 EUSO president, and have been playing the violin in the orchestra for 2 years now. I'm a 3rd year Maths and Music student and want to help everyone feel welcome and musical in the orchestra this coming year 🙂
